title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 02, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.7 (Peaked November 02, 2026 at 06:08 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 427 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)

The Sun's behaving itself. 🖤

Several bright active regions and a dark filament are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no obvious large outward structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
